basic_profile.bio: I'm a 32-year-old retail manager based in Pittsburgh, PA. I have a passion for comfortable and stylish footwear, especially boots like Dr. Martens. When I'm not working, I love experimenting with chocolate recipes and exploring new pasta dishes. My online hours are mostly during late evenings after work. I'm single and enjoy spending my weekends hiking or checking out the latest in smart wearable technology.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, which helps in managing retail operations. My knowledge about chocolate and pasta comes from years of self-teaching and trying out new recipes. My interest in smart glasses and technology is fueled by reading tech blogs and participating in online discussions.
